recommendation: Keep this external-repo audit for core. Future Permission rule-value semantic changes should be made in HL7/data-access-policies unless a later final work-group decision moves Permission back into the active FHIR core build.
issue_request: FHIR-43583 was an Applied/Persuasive Security issue for R5 asking to clarify how multiple values under Permission.rule, especially data and activity, are interpreted, with the intuitive interpretation that any combination of repeated data and activity values is subject to the rule's permit or deny decision.
initial_application: No historical source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-43583 was found. The same ambiguity was handled through the related FHIR-44748 Permission AND/OR clarification: Security WG minutes discussed FHIR-43583 and FHIR-44748 together, then approved FHIR-44748, and merge commit 2268c17c01881bb6256b9c2a61c98afd75396e98 added Permission Rules Processing Logic plus StructureDefinition comments for Permission.rule.data and Permission.rule.activity.
additional_context: Permission was later removed from the active core build by 0e2a8a7f839d5e1a43787523daccf07d958362f3, which deleted source/permission and active fhir.ini entries. Current core Security/history pages link Permission to the HL7 Data Access Policies IG, and the current external StructureDefinition-Permission.xml retains the repeated data/activity OR semantics and within-repetition AND semantics.
reconciliation: Made no core source change and published an empty audit commit. Editing or reintroducing core source/permission would be out of current build scope, while the current external Permission source already conveys the requested repeated-value rule interpretation.

related_jiras.note: Applied Permission AND/OR clarification that added the source comments satisfying FHIR-43583; already represented on the combined branch by 308414fee5070117b98514ecd0b0f533282008ae.
